# Superpowers pin

Upstream: https://github.com/obra/superpowers
Tag: v7.0.1
Commit: 2ce8aa15d05bd57213e6f746f953aafb7ded7a8b
License: MIT (`LICENSE` in this directory). These files stay MIT. They are not relicensed.

`SHA256SUMS` covers every other file in this directory, including this pin once
the sums are generated. Regenerate from this directory after a deliberate pin
move, not after an edit.

Included because `executing-plans` calls them: `writing-plans`,
`test-driven-development`, `systematic-debugging`,
`verification-before-completion`, `requesting-code-review`, and the
`subagent-driven-development` scripts `sdd-workspace`, `review-package`, and
`task-brief`.

Not included: the `subagent-driven-development` skill text and the rest of
the Superpowers catalog. This kit did not show a gap that needs a second
orchestrator. `using-git-worktrees` and `finishing-a-development-branch` are
not installed. The project entry point is `.cursor/skills/governed-work/SKILL.md`.
